description: The 3DS launcher's screen tuning: tools/build/gen_launcher_tuning.py writes it with the PC program's colours (core/gui/qt/theme.py) into tools/build/installer_3ds/source/hf_tuning.h. Speeds and times are the first install's guesses, replaced by the console's own once it has installed (timings.json); install_kib_s is a New 3DS XL's CIA route (1.8 MB/s); mod_title_per_set is the guess of the mod title's size over its patch set's (the title's exact size replaces it once the set is open).
